Selected Research

研究精选

Selected Research

2025.11 – 2026.04

基于语音多模态大模型的二语学术汉语写作改练智能体

以豆包大模型为基座，构建“错误聚焦—正确示范—朗读—自适应焦点迁移练习—反馈推进”六步闭环；主导对照实验（40 名 HSK 5–6 级学习者、3 周干预、200 份写作样本），发现多模态反馈在写作质量与元语言知识上优于纯文本方案，并具备延时保持效应。

2025.11 – 2026.04

A speech-multimodal LLM writing coach for academic Chinese

Built on the Doubao model, the agent runs a six-step loop: error focus, model answer, read-aloud, adaptive transfer practice, and feedback. I led a controlled study (40 HSK 5–6 learners, three-week intervention, 200 writing samples) showing that multimodal feedback improves writing quality and metalinguistic knowledge over a text-only baseline, with delayed retention.

2025.01 – 2025.06

音准星：基于微调大模型的汉语智能发音评估与可视化辅导平台

集成 Azure 语音评估、DeepSeek-V3 与 CosyVoice2 的发音测评 Web 产品。参照《国际中文教育中文水平等级标准》搭建多维判定标准，梳理 620+ 条分级语料与 40+ 类偏误的反馈模板，并主导 86 份用户反馈的归因与 5 项功能迭代。

2025.01 – 2025.06

Yinzhunxing: an LLM-based platform for Chinese pronunciation assessment

A web product integrating Azure speech assessment, DeepSeek-V3 and CosyVoice2. I helped define multi-dimensional scoring criteria against the Chinese Proficiency Grading Standards, curated 620+ graded practice texts and feedback templates for 40+ error types, and led the analysis of 86 user responses that drove five rounds of feature iteration.

2024.11 – 2025.06

外向型汉语学习电子词典：现状、问题与优化策略

从内容准确性、例句库、发音示范、界面交互与个性化推荐五个维度，评估 JUZI 汉语、Pleco 等 5 款主流产品；结合 120 份问卷、深度访谈与成语习得对照实验，归纳 20 余项问题并提出优化路径。项目成果获“挑战杯”北京市一等奖。

2024.11 – 2025.06

Electronic dictionaries for learners of Chinese: status, problems and optimisation

Evaluating five leading products, including JUZI Chinese and Pleco, across content accuracy, example banks, pronunciation models, interface and personalisation. Drawing on 120 survey responses, in-depth interviews and an idiom-acquisition experiment, we identified 20+ problems and proposed a five-part improvement strategy. First prize (Beijing), Challenge Cup.
